nodes.label: Packaging Industry Hero — Plastic Film Rolls
nodes.description: Hero-format studio photograph of multiple rolls of plastic packaging film in transparent, light blue, yellow-cream, and sage green, arranged on a white background. Represents the packaging industry use case for masterbatch colorants.

nodes.label: Packaging Industry Hero — Macro Colored Plastic Film Strips
nodes.description: Macro close-up of overlapping transparent and translucent plastic film strips in vivid colors — blue, green, purple, amber, and orange — on a white background. Emphasizes the iridescent, colorful quality of masterbatch-tinted packaging films.

nodes.label: Pipes & Fittings Industry Hero — HDPE Pipe Sections
nodes.description: Hero-format studio photograph of large-diameter and small-diameter black HDPE corrugated and smooth plastic pipes, arranged on a white pedestal. Labels visible: 'HDPE PE100 PN16 315mm OD'. Represents the pipes and fittings industry use case.

nodes.label: Textiles Industry Hero — Colored Yarn Spools
nodes.description: Hero-format photograph of multiple large industrial yarn/thread spools in a spectrum of vivid colors — yellow, blue, orange, red, green, cyan, purple — on a factory floor with machinery in the background. Represents the textiles industry use case for masterbatch colorants.

nodes.label: Wire & Cable Industry Hero — Multi-Core Power Cable
nodes.description: Hero-format studio photograph of a heavy-duty multi-core electrical cable with black outer jacket and exposed copper conductors color-coded in red, blue, black, and yellow insulation. Label reads 'H1ZZZ2-K HV 240mm² FLAME RESISTANT EN 50618'. Represents the wire and cable industry use case.

nodes.label: Agriculture Industry Card — Plastic Mulch Film on Seedling
nodes.description: Industry card image showing a young strawberry seedling planted through a hole in reflective silver/white plastic agricultural mulch film, with a greenhouse or polytunnel structure visible in the background at golden hour. Represents the agriculture industry use case for masterbatch in agricultural films.

nodes.label: Automotive Industry Card — Luxury Car Interior Dashboard
nodes.description: Industry card close-up of a premium car interior showing navy-blue leather upholstery, textured black plastic dashboard trim, and chrome control knobs and buttons. Represents the automotive industry use case for masterbatch in interior plastic components.

nodes.label: Construction Industry Card — Rubber/Plastic Drainage Mat
nodes.description: Industry card macro photograph of black studded plastic/rubber drainage or protection membrane sheet, with visible industrial manufacturing floor in the background. Represents the construction industry use case for masterbatch in geomembranes and drainage products.

nodes.label: Consumer Goods Industry Card — Plastic Bottle Caps and Closures
nodes.description: Industry card macro photograph of an assortment of plastic bottle caps, closures, and fittings in varying shades of blue and white. Items include screw caps, child-resistant press-and-turn caps, push-fit inserts, and a PE-HD marked cap. Represents the consumer goods industry use case for masterbatch.

nodes.label: Packaging Industry Card — Crumpled Clear and Blue Plastic Film
nodes.description: Industry card macro close-up of crumpled, layered transparent and blue-tinted plastic packaging film, showing geometric fold patterns and light refraction. Represents the packaging industry use case for masterbatch colorants in film.

nodes.label: Packaging Industry Card — Macro Colored Plastic Film Strips
nodes.description: Card-format version of the macro close-up of overlapping transparent and translucent plastic film strips in vivid multi-colors — blue, green, purple, amber, and orange. Visually identical to the hero macro counterpart at the same resolution.

nodes.label: Pipes & Fittings Industry Card — PE and PPR Pipe Cross-Sections
nodes.description: Industry card photograph showing two cut plastic pipes on a workbench in an industrial setting: a large black PE100 HDPE pipe and a smaller blue PPR (PN25 50mm S2.5) water supply pipe. Represents the pipes and fittings industry use case.

nodes.label: Textiles Industry Card — Blue Synthetic Fiber Ball
nodes.description: Industry card macro photograph of a tangled ball of thin blue and silver-white synthetic fiber strands, shot against a blue-toned fabric background. Represents the textiles industry use case for masterbatch colorants in synthetic fiber production.

nodes.label: Wire & Cable Industry Card — Industrial Grade Multi-Core Cables
nodes.description: Industry card photograph of two industrial-grade multi-core electrical cables — one blue (CABLETECH INDUSTRIAL H07RN-F) and one black — with exposed copper conductors visible. Label reads 'CABLETECH INDUSTRIAL INDUSTRY-GRADE H07RN-F 450/750V'. Represents wire and cable industry use case.

nodes.label: Colored Masterbatch Product Card — Blue Plastic Pellets
nodes.description: Product card photograph of scattered small cylindrical plastic pellets (masterbatch granules) in a spectrum of blue shades — royal blue, turquoise, teal, and white — floating and dispersed against a clean white background. Directly represents Blau Batch's colored masterbatch product offering.

nodes.label: White Masterbatch Product Card — White Plastic Pellets
nodes.description: Product card photograph of scattered small white cylindrical plastic pellets (masterbatch granules) dispersed against a warm off-white background. Directly represents Blau Batch's white masterbatch product offering with TiO2-based opacifying concentrate.

edges.note: Both depict plastic packaging film for the packaging industry; hero shows film rolls, card shows crumpled film detail
Both serve the packaging industry visual identity; hero shows film rolls, card macro shows colorful film strips
Hero and card versions appear to be the same source image — identical visual content (macro colored film strips)
Both represent the packaging industry through close-up plastic film imagery
Both depict plastic pipe products for the pipes and fittings industry; hero shows studio-arranged HDPE pipes, card shows cross-section cuts in an industrial setting
Both depict textile fiber/thread for the textiles industry; hero shows colorful yarn spools, card shows a macro ball of synthetic fiber
Both depict multi-core electrical cables for the wire and cable industry; hero shows a single high-voltage cable, card shows industrial-grade H07RN-F cables
Colored masterbatch pellets are the input material used to color packaging films
Colored masterbatch is the product that produces the colored packaging films shown in the hero
Colored masterbatch pellets are used to pigment synthetic textile fibers/yarns
Colored masterbatch is the upstream material enabling the blue synthetic fiber shown in the card
Colored masterbatch is used for the color-coded insulation sheathing of electrical cables
White masterbatch (TiO2) provides opacity and UV protection in plastic pipe manufacturing
White masterbatch is used to produce the white plastic bottle caps and closures shown in the consumer goods card
Both are masterbatch product types offered by Blau Batch; white is a sub-category of the broader colored masterbatch product line
Automotive interior plastic components rely on masterbatch for consistent color in dashboard trim and upholstery-adjacent plastics
Black construction drainage membranes typically use carbon black masterbatch for UV stability and coloration
Silver/white agricultural mulch films typically use white masterbatch or reflective additives for light management and UV resistance

hyperedges.label: Industry Visual Library
hyperedges.description: All industry-focused visual assets (hero images and card images) across all sectors served by Blau Batch: Packaging, Pipes & Fittings, Textiles, Wire & Cable, Agriculture, Automotive, Construction, and Consumer Goods. Forms the complete Industry Visual Library used across the website.

hyperedges.label: Product Card Visual Library
hyperedges.description: All product card visuals representing Blau Batch's masterbatch product offerings — colored and white masterbatch pellets. These are the upstream material inputs that connect to every industry visual in the library.

hyperedges.label: Packaging Industry Image Cluster
hyperedges.description: All visual assets representing the packaging industry, including two hero images (film rolls and macro film strips) and two card images. Packaging is the most visually represented industry in the asset library with four dedicated images.

hyperedges.label: Pipes & Fittings Industry Image Cluster
hyperedges.description: Visual assets representing the pipes and fittings industry — a hero studio shot of HDPE pipes and a card image of cut pipe cross-sections in an industrial environment.

hyperedges.label: Textiles Industry Image Cluster
hyperedges.description: Visual assets representing the textiles industry — a hero image of colorful yarn spools on a factory floor and a card macro of a blue synthetic fiber ball.

hyperedges.label: Wire & Cable Industry Image Cluster
hyperedges.description: Visual assets representing the wire and cable industry — a hero image of a high-voltage flame-resistant cable and a card image of industrial H07RN-F rated cables.

hyperedges.label: Card-Only Industry Visuals (Agriculture, Automotive, Construction, Consumer Goods)
hyperedges.description: Industries that have card-format visuals but no corresponding standalone hero image in the industries/ directory: Agriculture (mulch film), Automotive (interior trim), Construction (drainage membrane), and Consumer Goods (plastic closures). These may be secondary industries in the site's information architecture.

hyperedges.label: Masterbatch Product to Industry Application Supply Chain
hyperedges.description: The full supply-chain visual narrative: masterbatch pellet products (colored and white) are the upstream inputs that enable colorization and performance in every downstream industry application shown across the site's visual library.
